# Landed Digital

> Landed Digital is a Melbourne-based digital services business that helps Australian local businesses get found on Google, generate more genuine customer reviews, build websites that convert, and use practical AI to reduce repetitive admin work. It is a sub-brand of Landed Group.

Landed Digital works with local and small to medium Australian businesses: barbers, hair salons, beauty clinics, mechanics, trades, dentists, medical and allied health clinics, gyms, hospitality venues, retail stores, real estate agencies, professional services, home service businesses, new businesses and multi-location businesses.

The business positions itself as one practical partner across four connected areas (Google visibility, customer reviews, websites and AI automation) rather than a traditional full-service marketing agency. Landed Digital is an independent Australian business and is not affiliated with, or endorsed by, Google.

## Services

- [Google Services](https://digital.landedgroupau.com/google.html): Google Business Profile setup, optimisation and management, local SEO, Google Ads setup and management, Google Analytics and Search Console, conversion tracking, search visibility audits.
- [Review Engine](https://digital.landedgroupau.com/reviews.html): NFC tap-to-review cards, QR review codes, counter review stands, direct Google review links, staff review request processes, review response support, multi-location review systems.
- [AI Office](https://digital.landedgroupau.com/ai-office.html): AI receptionist, AI website chat assistant, missed call response systems, FAQ automation, lead capture and qualification, appointment and quote request workflows, follow-up automation, internal knowledge assistants.
- [Websites](https://digital.landedgroupau.com/websites.html): conversion-focused website design and development for local businesses, mobile performance, click-to-call, enquiry forms, Google and review integration, analytics and conversion tracking.
- [Packages](https://digital.landedgroupau.com/packages.html): four productised packages (Google Foundation, Review Engine, AI Office, Growth Accelerator). Pricing is quoted up front before work begins and is not published on the website.

## Offers

- Free Google Review NFC Setup: one programmed NFC review card, a QR code and a direct Google review link, set up at no cost for eligible Australian businesses. One setup per business. No payment details required. Claim at https://digital.landedgroupau.com/free-review-setup.html
- Free Business Check: a free, no-obligation review of a business's Google Business Profile, search visibility, website performance, review position and enquiry process. Book at https://digital.landedgroupau.com/contact.html

## What an NFC review card is

An NFC (Near Field Communication) review card is a physical card programmed so that when a customer taps it with their smartphone, or scans the QR code printed on it, their phone opens the business's Google review page directly. It removes the need for the customer to search for the business by name. Modern iPhones and most Android phones support NFC, and the QR code works on any smartphone camera as a backup. Cards can be reprogrammed if business details change.

## Client results

- [The Golden Fade Barbershop](https://digital.landedgroupau.com/results.html), Melbourne: Google Business Profile setup and a tap-to-review system across two shops. The established Caroline Springs shop has grown past 200 genuine Google reviews. A new Oakleigh South location reached 16 Google reviews in its first week of trading.
- [HazTech Autoworks](https://digital.landedgroupau.com/results.html), Melbourne mobile mechanic: Google Business Profile management and Google Ads. Holds a 5.0 rating across 34 genuine Google reviews, with a reported 250 percent increase in profile visits, 150 percent increase in calls from Google, and 4 to 5 new customer enquiries per day.

## Policy on reviews

Landed Digital only helps businesses collect genuine, voluntarily submitted Google reviews. It does not support review gating, filtering which customers are asked, suppressing negative feedback, incentivising reviews, or buying reviews. It does not guarantee Google rankings, review numbers or revenue.
